$Comment: The health half of Martha's dishes: eating a Turkey Pie or Martha's Roast puts it on. Shaped like the game's best meat buff (Meat_Buff_T3), stronger and longer: max health times 1.20 where the game's is 1.15, and 8% less physical and projectile damage where the game's is 5%, for 600 seconds (ten minutes) where the game's lasts six. Overwrite means eating another dish restarts it, never stacks it; each dish also clears the game's own meat buffs as it lands. Tune Amount or Duration here and both dishes follow; their descriptions in items.lang write these numbers out (Health Boost IV), so change them with it.
Name: items.effect.harvest_feast_food_health.name
